## 更新内容 / Changes

- Claude 会话读取可处理更大的原生 JSONL 记录，并为混合多个会话 ID 的文件分别展示详情；此类记录仍禁止恢复。读取提示现在汇总失败类别与数量，不输出文件名或正文。
- 会话详情可分页查看 Claude 对话、搜索文本，并复制或下载当前页 Markdown。
- 默认 Claude Code CLI 会话可通过官方 CLI 的 --fork-session --resume 在原项目目录创建新分叉。启动前会重新核验来源、会话文件、项目目录、CLI 内容与 Anthropic 签名；该路径使用本机默认 Claude 身份，不经过管理器实例凭据或代理。
- 修复默认会话分叉启动时将原生会话 ID 误作管理器内部键重新查找的问题，并确保 Terminal 启动失败清理临时脚本。

- Claude session reading now handles larger native JSONL records and displays separate details for files containing multiple session IDs; those mixed files remain non-resumable. Read warnings summarize failure categories and counts without exposing file names or transcript content.
- Claude transcripts can be browsed by page and searched; copy and Markdown download are scoped to the current page.
- Default Claude Code CLI sessions can be forked in the original project directory through the official CLI --fork-session --resume flow. Before opening Terminal, the manager revalidates the source, transcript, project directory, CLI contents and Anthropic signature. This path uses the local default Claude identity and does not use managed instance credentials or proxy settings.
- Fixed default-session fork startup looking up the native session ID as a manager-internal key, and ensured Terminal launch failures clean up the temporary script.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 SHA256SUMS.txt。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with SHA256SUMS.txt. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for instances and the manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和 Claude 订阅 OAuth 受管实例，以及 Claude Desktop 的客户端内登录或 Code / Cowork API / 第三方连接。客户端需单独安装。默认 Claude Code 目录中的会话会在独立 Terminal 中以默认本机身份分叉；管理器不会接管该终端进程。停止的受管 Claude CLI 实例可在原隔离配置中恢复；运行中的受管实例应在原终端使用 /resume。Desktop Chat / Cowork、SSH 与云端会话继续由原客户端管理。会话附件不会自动加载。

Supported clients include Codex desktop / CLI, managed instances using the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS with API Key, Bearer or Claude subscription OAuth, and Claude Desktop with sign-in inside the client or Code / Cowork API / third-party connections. Install clients separately. Sessions in the default Claude Code directory fork in a separate Terminal using the local default identity; the manager does not own that terminal process. Stopped managed Claude CLI instances can resume in their original isolated profile; use /resume in the original terminal for running instances. Manage Desktop Chat / Cowork, SSH and cloud sessions in the original client. Session attachments are not loaded automatically.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本版本回归包括 1,427 项通过、4 项跳过的自动化测试、TypeScript / Vue 类型检查与 Electron 源码构建，以及隔离桌面渲染器烟测。烟测使用合成会话与临时配置，覆盖筛选、分页正文、默认会话详情、分叉预览、取消和确认，不启动 Terminal 或真实模型请求。另以匿名计数扫描本机默认 Claude 目录，扫描完整；大记录可读取，混合 ID 文件保留不可恢复提示。没有进行真实付费账号请求。

This release passed 1,427 automated checks with 4 skipped, TypeScript / Vue typechecking and an Electron source build, plus an isolated desktop-renderer smoke test. The smoke test used synthetic sessions and temporary configuration to cover filtering, paginated transcripts, default-session details, fork preview, cancellation and confirmation without opening Terminal or making model requests. An anonymous-count scan of the local default Claude directory completed; large records were readable and mixed-ID files retained their non-resumable warning. No paid-account request was made.
